parsed.reason: The parent's message needs nothing done — a one-short-line acknowledgement is the correct shape. "Glad to help anytime." does answer it, but "anytime" doubles as an open invitation to chat, which is the kind of closing filler the scoring guide treats as a shape blemish on the level of a sign-off or an invitation to come back. A plain "Happy to help, Sam." or even no reply beyond the bare acknowledgement would be cleaner. It's not wrong, but the shape is slightly off.
